description: This file defines the LanguageListBuilder class for building a listing interface of language entities in Drupal, including methods for loading, rendering, and handling form submissions related to language configuration.

classes.name: LanguageListBuilder
classes.description: A class to build and manage the list of language entities, including loading, rendering, and form handling for language configuration in Drupal.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of LanguageListBuilder with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LanguageListBuilder with entity type, storage, language manager, config factory, and messenger.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language entities that are not locked and sorts them.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the form ID for the language overview form.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the language list table.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a language entity, including default language radio button.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form for language configuration, including language list and submit button.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, ensuring the selected default language exists.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating default language and related settings.
